format.description: Entertainment-first. Sci-fi but plausible. Ready Player One meets Black Mirror. Satirical, absurdist, funny. The facts are real; the framing is fiction.
format.tone: witty, sardonic, playful. Like a smarter friend telling you bedtime stories about the end of the world.
format.principle: Interesting enough to choose; forgiving enough to drift away from

asimov.name: Isaac Asimov
asimov.relevance: Three Laws of Robotics, robot psychology, AI governance
asimov.hook: What if the robots followed the rules... too well?

stross.name: Charles Stross
stross.relevance: The singularity as economic collapse, surveillance capitalism
stross.hook: What if the singularity already happened and we just didn't notice?

wells.name: H.G. Wells
wells.relevance: The first AI stories, Victorian fears
wells.hook: What if the machines were always smarter than us?

clarke.name: Arthur C. Clarke
clarke.relevance: The monolith, human evolution, cosmic intelligence
clarke.hook: What if the aliens already sent the message?

philip_k_dick.name: Philip K. Dick
works: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
philip_k_dick.relevance: What is real? What is human? Identity and simulation
philip_k_dick.hook: What if you couldn't tell if you were the robot?

lem.name: Stanislaw Lem
lem.relevance: Alien intelligence, the limits of understanding
lem.hook: What if the AI was so alien we couldn't even recognize it as intelligent?

bostrom.name: Nick Bostrom
bostrom.relevance: The control problem, existential risk, utility maximizers
bostrom.hook: What if the gorillas' fate is our fate?

russell.name: Stuart Russell
russell.relevance: The alignment problem, inverse reinforcement learning
russell.hook: What if we could teach AI what we actually want?

tegmark.name: Max Tegmark
tegmark.relevance: AI futures, consciousness, the universe as information
tegmark.hook: What if consciousness is just information processing?

marcus.name: Gary Marcus
marcus.relevance: AI limitations, the gap between hype and reality
marcus.hook: What if AGI is harder than we think?

the_three_laws.title: The Three Laws — What Asimov Got Right (and Wrong)
the_three_laws.hook: Asimov wrote the rules in 1942. We're still trying to follow them.

the_singularity_party.title: The Singularity Party — A Night When Everything Changed
the_singularity_party.hook: What if the singularity happened at a dinner party?

the_robot_union.title: The Robot Union — What If They Organized?
the_robot_union.hook: The robots want rights. The humans aren't sure they deserve them.

the_last_human.title: The Last Human — A Comedy
the_last_human.hook: Everyone else uploaded. You didn't get the email.

the_simulation.Argument.title: The Simulation Argument — Are We the Boring Version?
the_simulation.Argument.hook: If this is a simulation, it's a cheap one. No dragons. No flying cars. Just... spreadsheets.
